case: orphan envelope row — no body, no document_id; source_msg_id falls back to rowid:<n> (mail.js:433-435)
notes: No .emlx body resolved, document_id empty. The connector stamps source_msg_id = rowid:<n>. From is synthesized from the addresses-table header. content is null (no body). thread_id falls back to source_msg_id when there is no Message-Id / References / In-Reply-To. P1: the From local-part 'noreply' is a STRUCTURAL role address -> sender.kind 'service' (an automated, non-person channel) via the shared classifyStructural helper.
